derived_from: sprint1/configs/frozen_baseline.json (s2_B_base, frozen 5 Oct by the experimenter)
unchanged: model code (sprint1.models.baseline), optimizer code (sprint1.harness.optim), LR schedule (sprint1.harness.train.lr_factor), every optimizer/schedule value, size small 6L/384d, seq 1024, batch 65536 tokens, softcap 15, unet, bf16 autocast + torch.compile on CUDA

changed.tokenizer: byte-level BPE 16384 trained on train_10M (was GPT-2 50257, padded 50304)
changed.budget: 10 epochs of the split, sampled as a fresh permutation of tiled windows per epoch (was a single pass over uniformly random windows of FineWeb)
changed.evaluation: DEV-sub / TRAIN-sub (~1M words each) at word milestones + full BabyLM dev at the end; nats/word, nats/token, bits/byte (was FineWeb val first half)
